firstContext: 🗣️ Ruth to Lucas, by the fire: "Stone. We need 46 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (20/11/8), with 4 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 17 · Craft 9 · Talk 15 · Explore 39 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ OUTSHONE — Maya Singh did what you would not: acted, boldly, while there was still time. The village thrives. The god is someone else. The record notes, kindly and accurately, that you watched. It stings exactly as much as it should.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
